comment: E-PROFILE 910 nm stations OUTSIDE the regional CAMS download domain (Europe/N-Atlantic, lat 27-74 lon -27-45). Each gets a small per-station CAMS box with the LEAN variable set (t/q/z/lnsp only, no aerosol backscatter): enough for the water-vapor correction + molecular profile, but NOT OmB. scripts/download_cams_oob.py reads this file and writes <cams_dir>/<wmo>/CAMS_Beta_YYYYMM.nc; the calibration routes a station to that folder via station_id (calibration/io/cams.py). 1064 nm (CHM15k) and 532 nm (Mini-MPL) instruments need no CAMS (US Std 1976 molecular profile, no WV) and are not listed here. box = ADS area [North, West, South, East].
